household_types.description: Groups of young international students, largely from India, China and other Asian countries, sharing rented houses or apartments near the university. They work part-time in retail, hospitality or on campus, have modest incomes, and prioritise affordability and proximity to campus and public transport over space.
household_types.housing_hint: Shared 3-4 bedroom house or apartment, often older rental stock near campus or the railway line

household_types.description: Early-career professionals and postgraduate students living alone or as a couple in compact dwellings. They are highly educated, often rent, and value easy access to the city, work and study, with low car dependence and modern amenities.
household_types.housing_hint: One- or two-bedroom unit, apartment or townhouse, frequently rented
